cases.reviewerAnswer: Positive agreement: A mí también. Negative agreement: A mí tampoco. Contrasting replies: A mí no; A mí sí.
Identify the speaker's likes, preferences, needs, and plans from short recordings.
cases.notes: The scope explicitly stages the later preference, need, and plan constructions across L2–L4.

cases.reviewerAnswer: a mí también: me too, with the experiencer expressed as an indirect object.
a mí tampoco: me neither, in the negative preference exchanges taught here.
bailar: to dance; a regular -ar verb.
encantar: to delight or appeal strongly; me encanta and me encantan in this lesson.
el fútbol: football; masculine, with a written accent.
gustar: to appeal to someone; me gusta with a singular noun or infinitive, me gustan with a plural noun.
nadar: to swim; a regular -ar verb.
la película; las películas. Película de terror means horror film.
tampoco expresses negative addition. Replies include A mí tampoco with gustar or encantar, and Yo tampoco with appropriate subject-based constructions.
cases.defect: The blanket distinction between gustar and all other verbs is false. Encantar, already included in this lesson, also takes A mí tampoco in the equivalent exchange.
cases.correction: Restrict Yo tampoco to constructions where the corresponding person is the subject, and explicitly include encantar with the gustar pattern.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 35, indirect objects and dative experiencers (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, encantar, the sense expressing strong liking (from memory).
